nutrition_logging.reason: Daily photo logging was more friction than it was worth. The goal is to eat more, which does not require tracking to execute.
nutrition_logging.note: Logged data to date ran slightly above his normal diet, so ~2500 is the honest baseline. Protein is handled by habit and is not tracked. The dashboard and logging pipeline are untouched and work the moment he sends a photo again. Nothing about target-setting breaks: targets were always set by the 7-day weight trend, never by logged intake.

targets.note: Provisional. Derived from Mifflin-St Jeor at 170 lb / 74 in with a 1.6 activity multiplier, plus a ~250 kcal surplus. With intake logging paused these function as a directional reference, not something to hit precisely. The weekly review reads the weight trend and gives a direction, eat more or hold, rather than a number to count to.

streak_rules.note: Calories are deliberately not a streak condition. Photo estimates are too noisy to gate a streak on. Dormant while nutrition logging is paused.

review_cadence.weekly: Sunday. Read the weight trend and give a direction on intake. Generate next week's three sessions plus two optional add-ins.
review_cadence.monthly: Progress summary. InBody, tape, lift progression, adherence.
